states.entryAction: Speak field label and optional help or examples.
states.description: System-orientation prompt for the currently focused field.

states.entryAction: Activate STT and wait for usable speech input.
states.description: Speech capture is active for the focused field.

states.entryAction: Map transcript to intent, command, or field value candidate.
Apply constraints and field-level acceptance rules.
states.description: Candidate value is checked before confirmation.

states.entryAction: Read back the interpreted value and request acceptance when needed.
states.description: User can confirm or reject the current value.

states.entryAction: Speak an error or remediation prompt for the current field interaction.
states.description: Runtime explains the problem and prepares the next listen attempt.
Reference runtimes may use this as the field-level correction point after confirmation rejection; richer runtimes can extend it with slot-, word-, or character-level repair.

transitions.description: Prompt playback finished and the runtime opens listening.
A usable transcript was captured.
No usable input arrived before timeout and the prompt is repeated.
Runtime enters remediation after repeated no-input failures.
Transcript interpretation produced a candidate for validation.
A readback offer answered during interpretation (the low-confidence spelling escalation) is the same user rejection as at a confirmation turn and enters correction mode.
Candidate value passed validation and can be confirmed.
Validation failed and a remediation prompt is spoken.
Current field interaction is complete and control returns to the outer dialog flow.
User rejected the interpreted value and correction mode begins.
Remediation prompt completed and the runtime retries listening.
Repair input completed and the runtime captures the corrected value.

states.entryAction: Speak the field-group orientation prompt before iterating fields.
Iterate the fields of the active field group.
states.description: Normal field interaction loop for the active group.

states.entryAction: Speak the current field-group summary before leaving the group.
states.description: Review point for the active field group.

states.entryAction: Speak the overall process summary before final submission.
Finalize the dialog as successfully submitted.

transitions.description: Orientation finished and field interaction begins.
User confirmed cancellation during group intro.
The active field group is complete and enters review.

transitions.guard: A later field group exists and becomes the active group before re-entry.
transitions.description: Explicit navigation advances to another field group.

transitions.guard: An earlier field group exists and becomes the active group before re-entry.
transitions.description: Explicit navigation moves back to another field group.

transitions.guard: A concrete target field group is resolved before re-entry.
transitions.description: Jump navigation activates a different field group.
User confirmed cancellation while iterating fields.

transitions.guard: Another field group remains after the current group.
transitions.description: Accepting the current summary advances to the next group.

transitions.guard: The current group is the last remaining field group.
transitions.description: Accepting the final group summary opens the overall process review.
Rejecting the group summary returns to field interaction.
User confirmed cancellation while reviewing the current group.
User confirmed the process summary and submits the dialog.

transitions.guard: Runtime restores a concrete field group before re-entry.
transitions.description: Rejecting the final review returns to editable dialog flow.
User confirmed cancellation during final review.
